{{Quote|Master, I&hellip;''"<br />"''Take me with you. I want to learn. I can learn.|Finn's Sith apprentice and Marka|<ref name="The Apprentice" />}}
'''Marka''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] to the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Lod]]. Prior to the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan|end]] of the [[New Sith Wars]] in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], she encountered the [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] [[Finn (Sith)|Finn]] and [[Finn's Sith apprentice|his apprentice]]. After Lod struck Marka for disobeying her, the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Toydarian, freeing her. She used a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] on the apprentice in an attempt to convince him to take her with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], and she then followed the two Sith to their [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and begged Finn to allow her to accompany them. When the Sith Master refused, Marka seized the apprentice's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and pushed him off the building's docking pad to his death. She then assumed the role of Finn's new Sith apprentice.

==Biography==
{{Quote|She's still following us, Master."''<br />"''I know. Perhaps she is why we came to this dreadful place. There is no such thing as coincidence."''<br />"''I must deal with her."''<br />"''Yes. Deal with her.|The male Sith apprentice and Finn, regarding Marka|<ref name="The Apprentice" />}}
[[File:Watch that first step.png|thumb|right|200px|Marka killed Finn's Sith apprentice to take his place.]]
Marka, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], was [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Lod]]<ref name="The Apprentice" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] leading to the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan|end]] of the [[New Sith Wars]] in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{CSWECite|I|273|Finn}} states that [[Finn (Sith)|Finn]] was active in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] leading to the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan|Battle of Ruusan]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places at the end of the [[New Sith Wars]] in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]].</ref> She and Lod encountered the [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] [[Finn (Sith)|Finn]] and [[Finn's Sith apprentice|his apprentice]] on a [[Unidentified planet (Finn)|planet]] shortly after they destroyed a building. Lod ordered Marka to impress the men by showing them her [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]]; however, she refused. Lod struck her, and Finn's apprentice helped Marka to her feet, swearing that Lod would not hit her again. As Lod criticised the temper of Finn's "slave," to the Sith Master, the apprentice [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Toydarian with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] for the perceived insult, freeing Marka.<ref name="The Apprentice" />

After Finn rebuked his apprentice for helping Marka, she thanked her liberator and used a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] on the apprentice in an attempt to convince him to take her with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. She followed the apprentice as he went to tell Finn that she was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], and the Sith Master ordered his pupil to deal with Marka. However, she and the apprentice pursued Finn up the [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] which led to the docking pad where the Sith's [[Starship/Legends|starship]] was. Marka begged Finn to allow her to accompany them, saying that she could learn the Sith ways, but Finn refused, citing that he already had an apprentice and had no use for a slave. In response, Marka seized the apprentice's lightsaber and pushed him off the docking pad, sending him plummeting to his death. In response, Finn asked Marka if she was joining him,<ref name="The Apprentice" /> and she took her place as Finn's new Sith apprentice.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Thank you for freeing me. Please take me with you.''"<br />"''I&hellip;uh&hellip;must go&hellip;|Marka and Finn's Sith apprentice|<ref name="The Apprentice" />}}
[[File:TheApprentice2.jpg|thumb|left|130px|Marka, just prior to murdering Finn's Sith apprentice]]
When Finn's apprentice killed Lod and freed Marka, she was grateful for his actions, but she also attempted to convince him to take her with the Sith. After Finn initially refused to allow her to accompany them due to the fact that he had a pupil, she murdered the man who freed her from slavery in order to become Finn's apprentice.<ref name="The Apprentice" /> After becoming Finn's apprentice, he demanded absolute loyalty from Marka.<ref name="CSWE Finn">{{CSWECite|I|273|Finn}}</ref> Marka had light skin and [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. She also had blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] that turned red under the influence of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] after murdering Finn's previous apprentice.<ref name="The Apprentice" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Master&hellip;that girl&hellip;she&hellip;uh&hellip;I mean&hellip;''"<br />"''She tried a Force mind trick on you? Did you not sense it when they approached? The Force is powerful with her.|The male Sith apprentice and Finn|<ref name="The Apprentice" />}}
Marka was noted by Finn as powerful with the Force; the Sith Master was able to sense her ability when she and Lod approached him and his apprentice. Marka was able to use the mind trick ability, and utilized it on Finn's Sith apprentice. She also was able to kill [[Finn's Sith apprentice|Finn's apprentice]] with a sneak attack.<ref name="The Apprentice" />

==Equipment==
When she met Finn and his apprentice, Marka was wearing a dull yellow [[Clothing/Legends|tunic]] with lighter colored sleeves, along with a brown belt, gold hooped [[Piercing/Legends|earrings]], and knee-high sandals. When she killed Finn's apprentice, Marka claimed his red-bladed lightsaber.<ref name="The Apprentice" />

==Behind the scenes==
Marka appeared in the short [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] "[[The Apprentice (comic story)|The Apprentice]]," written by [[Mike Denning]], illustrated by [[David Nakayama]], and published in [[Star Wars Tales 17|''Star Wars Tales'' 17]],<ref name="The Apprentice" /> which was released on [[October 1]], [[2003]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/53995/star_wars_tales_1999_17|text=Star Wars Tales (1999) #17}}</ref> Plausible stories in [[Star Wars Tales 1|''Star Wars Tales'' 1]]&ndash;''[[Star Wars Tales 20|20]]'' were initially viewed as [[Canon|S-canon]] until referenced in a non-''Tales'' source, at which point the subject matter was elevated to C-canon status.<ref>{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=752#14952461|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2006-06-04|time=3:05 AM}}</ref> Marka received an entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'',<ref name="CSWE" /> elevating the character's appearance in ''The Apprentice'' to C-canon.
